variants.name: MMS-TTS Telugu (ONNX)
variants.notes: No official Meta or sherpa-onnx-team ONNX export of mms-tts-tel exists. This is a community conversion (willwade/mms-tts-multilingual-models-onnx), confirmed present on Hugging Face 2026-09-12 (model.onnx, tokens.txt, sample.wav in the tel/ folder). Documented here per the plan's instruction to use the correct current source rather than an outdated/nonexistent identifier.

variants.name: MMS-TTS Telugu (sherpa-onnx)
variants.architecture: VITS (sherpa-onnx compatible ONNX export of facebook/mms-tts-tel)
variants.notes: k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx's official tts-models release has no Telugu asset (checked GitHub release 2026-09-12). Using sriram09764/itantra-tts-onnx instead, a community conversion in the standard sherpa-onnx VITS layout (model.onnx + tokens.txt + config.json), confirmed present on Hugging Face. Not an officially maintained k2-fsa asset; documenting the substitution rather than silently treating it as official.
variants.failureReason: sherpa-onnx 1.13.8 OfflineTts.generate() segfaults (native crash) on this community ONNX conversion (sriram09764/itantra-tts-onnx), reproduced even with a single trivial Telugu word. Model loads fine; crash is inside synthesis. Likely an incomplete/incorrect ONNX export (missing embedded metadata sherpa-onnx's VITS runner expects) rather than an environment issue, since loading and the separate willwade ONNX export both work. Not pursued further; recorded as a genuine failure rather than retried indefinitely.

variants.name: Vakyansh Telugu Glow-TTS (female)
variants.notes: Checkpoint URL confirmed reachable (HTTP 200) and sized 2026-09-13. Vocoder is shared between both Telugu voices.
variants.failureReason: Inference requires compiling the repo's Cython monotonic_align extension (glow-tts alignment search), which needs a C compiler. No C compiler (MSVC/cl.exe or gcc) is present on this machine, and the system drive (C:) had only ~3GB free at the time, too little to safely install Visual Studio Build Tools (typically several GB). This is a build-toolchain gap, not a defect in the model itself; revisit if a compiler becomes available.

variants.name: IndicF5
variants.notes: Architecture, license and inference API confirmed from the model card 2026-09-13. Outputs 24000Hz. Requires a reference prompt audio + its transcript at inference time (voice cloning conditioned), which the model card's own repo ships in a prompts/ folder (no Telugu one included there, only Marathi and Punjabi).
variants.failureReason: ai4bharat/IndicF5 is a gated Hugging Face model: downloading requires a Hugging Face account to request and be granted access, then an API token to authenticate the download. No such account/token exists in this environment, and creating one or entering credentials is outside what an automated session should do. Needs the project owner to request access on huggingface.co/ai4bharat/IndicF5 with their own account and provide an HF_TOKEN before this can be installed.

variants.name: Chiluka TTS Telugu
variants.notes: Investigated 2026-09-13: huggingface.co/Seemanth/chiluka-tts returns HTTP 401 ("Invalid username or password") for anonymous access, and no corroborating reference to a Telugu "Chiluka" TTS model was found via web search. Not substituting a different model under this name; recording it as unverifiable rather than fabricating details.

variants.name: MahaTTS v2 Telugu
variants.architecture: Text-to-Semantic (Gemma-backbone causal LM) -> Semantic-to-Mel (flow) -> BigVGAN vocoder
variants.notes: Confirmed via Hugging Face API and README 2026-09-13: Telugu is explicitly listed as supported (multilingual/cross-lingual voice cloning via wav2vec2/M4T semantic tokens, not a Telugu-specific finetune). Not gated. Requires 3 reference audio clips at inference; the repo only ships Hindi reference speakers, no Telugu ones, so this project's own consistent reference-audio choice will be used instead. Total checkpoint size across 3 files (BigVGAN 450MB + T2S 3.3GB + S2A flow 863MB) = 4.6GB.
